name: Core
description: Company, branches, warehouses, tills, users, roles, devices, audit, modules, settings, catalog, prices and tax, stock ledger and the POS. Always installed.

permissions.label: Manage company profile, branches, warehouses and tills
View the audit log
Sign in to a POS till by PIN, open/close shifts and sell
View products, units, barcodes and prices
Create and edit products, units, barcodes, categories and brands
Change prices, price lists and tax set-up
View stock levels and movements
Enter opening stock and stock adjustments
Approve and post stock adjustments above the approval limit (not your own)
View till sales, receipts and shifts
View online orders
Prepare, fulfil and cancel online orders
Set up online stores and sales channels (including their API keys)
Create and edit suppliers and the products they supply
View purchase orders, goods received and supplier prices
Create purchase orders and submit them for approval
Approve purchase orders up to your limit (never your own)
Receive goods (GRN) and put them away into bins
Approve deliveries above the over-delivery tolerance and reverse goods received
Create, dispatch and receive stock transfers
Start stock counts and enter counted quantities
Approve and post stock counts (not your own)
Set up bins and reorder levels
Look up customers and their balances
Create and edit customers and their marketing consent
Set credit limits, payment terms and credit holds (head office)
Release credit holds and allow credit sales over the limit, up to your limit
View quotations, customer orders, deliveries and invoices
Create quotations and customer orders
Deliver customer orders (issues stock and raises the invoice)
View statements and aged receivables
Record customer payments
Issue credit notes
Set up promotions and coupons
Give discounts and change prices at the till, up to your limit (or approve them by PIN)
Approve returns without a receipt or after the return period (store credit only)
Sell, look up and void gift cards and store credit
View the chart of accounts, journals and financial reports
Post journals, reversals and opening balances
Change the chart of accounts and which accounts automatic posting uses
Close months once everything is posted and ties
Reopen a closed month (with a reason)
View supplier bills, payments and what is owed to suppliers
Enter supplier bills (matched to goods received)
Approve or reject bills whose prices differ from the order (never your own)
Record payments to suppliers
Set up bank, MoMo and cash accounts, import statements, reconcile and move money between accounts
Claim money spent for the business (with the receipt)
Approve or reject expense claims up to your limit (never your own)
Pay approved claims from petty cash or another account
Keep the fixed asset register, asset classes and disposals
Enter budgets per branch and account
View employees and departments (not pay)
Hire, update and end employees, with pay and bank details; set up departments and leave types
See timesheets and correct clock-in / clock-out times (with a reason)
Request your own leave and see your payslips
Approve or refuse leave (never your own)
Give staff loans and salary advances
Prepare and recalculate the monthly payroll
Approve the payroll (not one you prepared) and confirm the PAYE/SSNIT rules
Record that salaries were paid
Review and resolve offline and sync exceptions
Run sync, manage sync peers and settings, import/export sync files
View users and their access
Create and edit users, reset PINs
Edit roles and grant or revoke access
Register, enrol and revoke devices
Enable or disable modules per branch
Change system settings
Verify the audit hash chain
See forecasts, stock health, customer and pricing insights, cash-flow forecast and alerts
See loss-prevention risk scores for cashiers and shifts
Ask the copilot questions about the business (only data you may already see)
See the AI usage log (questions, answers, cost)
